free encyclopedia Norwegian kickboxer Mette Solli Personal information Nationality Norwegian Born ( 1974-09-14 ) 14 September 1974 (age 51) Molde , Norway Medal record Women's kickboxing Representing Norway World Championships 2001 Maribor Light-Contact -55 kg 2007 Coimbra Full-Contact -56 kg European Championships 2004 Budva Full-Contact -52 kg Mette Solli (born 14 September 1974) is a Norwegian kickboxer . Biography [ edit ] Solli was born in Molde on 17 September 1974. [ 1 ] Her achievements include gold medal in light-contact at the W.A.K.O. World Championships 2001 (Maribor) , a gold medal in full-contact at the W.A.K.O. European Championships 2004 (Budva) , and a gold medal in full-contact at the W.A.K.O. World Championships 2007 (Coimbra) . [ 1 ] She was awarded the Kongepokal (King's Cup) trophy at the national championships in 2007. [ 2 ] References [ edit ] ^ a b Bryhn, Rolf. "Mette Solli" .
